summary: Specifies how to put audio compressed with the ITU-T G.729.1 codec into Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP) packets for live streaming over IP. It also registers the media type for the payload format.

eli5.summary: Voices are squeezed into small packages to travel over the internet. This note says exactly how to pack one particular kind of squeezed voice so the other end can unpack it properly.

questions: how to send g.729.1 audio over rtp
